Name: More Stardew-y Relationship Indicators
Author: IllogicalMoodSwing
Description:
This Content Patcher mod changes the relationship indicator in the dialogue panel to coloured stars that are a bit more meaningful to the Stardew universe. 0-1 hearts is a question mark, then the stars go through copper (2-3 hearts), steel (4-5 hearts), gold (6-7 hearts) and iridium (8-9 hearts), and maximum hearts is a little prismatic square!

[b]Install[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
